# FathomDB engine module-boundary policy.
#
# Shrink-only reviewed inputs: module classifications, field/owner maps,
# forbid-dependency, forbid-cycle and allow-cycle lines, and the local-macro
# exceptions. Loosening any of them needs a reviewed plan change.
#
# Regenerable-with-review inventories: the `inherent` and `edge` lines. They
# are regenerated from `fathomdb-module-boundary-gate --report` and the diff
# is reviewed like code. `edge` lines cover only edges with at least one
# governed or root endpoint; edges between two non-governed modules are
# extracted for reachability and SCCs but are not frozen, and a policy line
# for one fails as out of scope.
